messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-06-19] standup/boreal/2025-06-19: As before, webhooks needs the event-bus to work.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-06-06] standup/cinder/2025-06-06: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-06-06] standup/ember/2025-06-06: Decided in today's standup: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, since the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2025-06-27] standup/cinder/2025-06-27: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.
- [2025-06-24] standup/dune/2025-06-24: Reporting still relies on Ledger; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-11-06] standup/boreal/2025-11-06: Marcus has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Lena.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-06-11] handover/2025-06-11-notifier: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06-2: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: The Atlas team this year is Priya Raman and Tomasz.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2: If the bus is down, the webhooks service is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-06-19] standup/atlas/2025-06-19: Rotation day for team Atlas: Priya hands the pager to Tomasz.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-11-06] handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags: Quick one: feature-flags belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to team Atlas for running it until now.
- [2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-scheduler: Handover: as of today scheduler moves from the Ember team to the Dune team. Oskar walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-06-09] handover/2025-06-09-billing-api: The Ember team handed billing-api to Boreal today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Lena Fischer.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-04-03] standup/atlas/2025-04-03: Reminder from team Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-04-02] standup/ember/2025-04-02: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-03-04] standup/atlas/2025-03-04: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-3: Release captain for Q3 2025: Farah.
- [2025-09-04] standup/dune/2025-09-04: Tomasz Nowak picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
